# GATEWAY_API

The Gateway API CRDs are registered, so Gateway and route kinds have types.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `gatewayApi`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.gatewayApi`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
